note: Injectable style cards only — craft traits, not full poems. Imitate breath/structure; never copy themes or lines.

cards.breath: short-long alternating; many 2-6 char lines; occasional long cascade
cards.verb_mode: 状态与象征动词并用：眺望/注视/流淌/纠缠/坠落/饮下
cards.prompt_snippet: 短行呼吸；同一光影/房间场内层递（夕阳→星→月→心脏）；intent标钩子类型；禁跨场词表与同义反复。
cards.prompt_snippet_en: Short breath; stay in one light/room field (sun→star→moon→heart); tag hook type in intent; no cross-field salad or synonym doubles.

cards.source: 朦胧诗蒙太奇 + 唐诗并置脱节（分析摘要）
cards.breath: 短行跳跃；意象撞击后留白
image_clusters: 自然正面 vs 锈蚀否定物
cards.verb_mode: 精炼、少解释，靠并置出张力
devices: 异质意象并置但同情绪公式
cards.prompt_snippet: 蒙太奇并置可以无语法粘合，但双方须共享情绪公式（如乡思/怀疑）；禁无场乱接的伪蒙太奇。
cards.prompt_snippet_en: Montage may drop grammar, but images must share one emotion-formula; ban fake montage across unrelated fields.

cards.source: 顾城式童话透明意象（分析摘要）
cards.prompt_snippet: 意象透明如童话观察：幻想与现实交界处轻轻落笔，忌口号与暴力词表填空。
cards.prompt_snippet_en: Fairy-clear observation at fantasy/reality edge; soft verbs; no slogan or violence-word checklists.

cards.source: 海子式大地/仪式短句（分析摘要）
cards.breath: 短句排比可有，但需变奏避免同构连发
cards.prompt_snippet: 大地与日常可神话化；短句可排比但必须变奏，禁止机械同构连发。
cards.prompt_snippet_en: Mythologize land/daily life; parallel lines must vary—no mechanical identical scaffolds.

cards.source: 近体诗节奏感（分析摘要，非格律硬套）
cards.breath: 四/五/七言尺度的呼吸参考，自由诗可借其顿挫
cards.prompt_snippet: 借近体顿挫与景情层递，不硬填格律；单字动词有力，忌典故说明书。
cards.prompt_snippet_en: Borrow classical breath and scene-to-feeling layering without forced meter; strong verbs; no allusion lectures.

cards.breath: short lines; concrete nouns; cut abstract sermon
cards.prompt_snippet: Imagist clarity: concrete nouns, exact verbs, one late turn; no not-but or itself-crutches.
cards.prompt_snippet_en: Imagist clarity: concrete nouns, exact verbs, one late turn; no not-but or itself-crutches.

cards.breath: uneven line lengths; questions allowed; climax imperative rare
cards.prompt_snippet: Uneven breath; address a you; memory flashes; avoid therapy-speak and slogan couplets.
cards.prompt_snippet_en: Uneven breath; address a you; memory flashes; avoid therapy-speak and slogan couplets.
